1.name: A Goblin!
1.notes: A sneaky looking goblin awaits on this path...

1.name: A Goblin Gang!
1.notes: You hear chittering and the click of goblin fingers...
1.text: You see a towering, shifting mass underneath what appears to be an old greatcoat. You can clearly see the outline of 3 goblins standing on each other's shoulders. As you enter, they turn to look at you and ready themselves for battle...

1.name: Chaos Slime
1.notes: A wildly erratic amorphous blob flies about...
1.text: As you enter this room, you see an amorphous blob jolt about, bouncing from wall to wall seemingly without reason...
1.abilityDescription: Randomly adds some amount of shield, damage, or heal on some turns

1.name: The Toll Troll
1.notes: A massive troll sits, watching as you approach

1.name: Skeleton Swordsman
1.notes: A gleaming sword and clattering bones...
1.text: A boney swordsman stands in perfect en garde, ready to begin a gentleman's duel...

1.name: Volcano Imp
1.notes: A small imp with a curiously flaming head
1.text: An imp stands, his head wreathed in flame. Every so often, the flame grows and explodes, superheating the air around the small critter.
1.abilityDescription: Adds additional damage, amount increases by 1 every turn.

2.name: Gremlin Swarm
2.notes: Razor sharp teeth and weirdly large ears...
2.text: You see a swarm of tiny critters in this room, with unusually large ears and pointy, needle-like teeth. As you enter the room, they begin to come towards you...

2.name: Stone Golem
2.text: A staunch and unfaltering behemoth sits before you. It towers above your head, and slowly begins to move with the sound of tectonic plates grinding together.

2.name: Steel Golem
2.text: A steely humanoid figure towers over you, its arms unreasonably long. You feel the ground shake under its immense weight as it turns towards you.
2.abilityDescription: Can't lose more than 3 health per turn from dice effects.

2.name: Silver Golem
2.text: A mechanical silver monstrosity looms over you. You can see your reflection in its silver skin, and you look scared...,
2.abilityDescription: Reflects all damage dealt to itself back onto the player

2.name: Kobold Saboteur
2.text: A crafty looking kobold sits in this room, tinkering with a number of confusing-looking components.
2.abilityDescription: Reduces one of the player's selected dice faces by a random amount.

2.name: Sun Priest
2.text: A priest dressed in white robes stands before you, an unnatural glow emanating from his skin.
2.abilityDescription: Revives himself with 30% of original health after death.

2.name: Assassin Vine
2.notes: Leafy green vines undulate slowly in the gloom...
2.text: As you enter this room, you see a tangle of spiky, verdant green vines begin to reach out towards you...
2.abilityDescription: Traps you in vines, cutting your damage in half until you free yourself by dealing 8 damage.
